_comment: One place for what testers read on each build: TestFlight's What to Test (tool/testflight.py) and Play's release notes (tool/play_upload.py). Change it with the version in pubspec.yaml; a build whose version is not this one says so in its notes instead of repeating an old release's.
what_to_test: Tap to Pay. Android: on any NFC phone (Android 10+), Settings > Card payments shows Tap to Pay; take a 1.00 sale and refund it. Dojo's SDK now decides whether the phone can take cards; any problem it reports is shown in plain words and logged to Vesopa. iPhone (registered test iPhones, Ad Hoc build): accept the Tap to Pay terms as a manager, see the how-to-tap screens, take a sale and a refund. Kitchen and display modes as in 1.2.32.
release_notes: Vesopa Go 1.2.33: Tap to Pay on Android through Dojo's SDK on any NFC phone, refunds through the SDK, clearer Tap to Pay messages, and Tap to Pay on iPhone for test devices.
